title: Director of Program Quality
text:
**Job Summary**

CLA seeks an experienced leader to oversee CLA’s Quality Program. Supervise the Quality Assurance Professional, Certified Professional Trainers, Community Case Management Program Manager, RN Association Nurse/CCM Clinical Supervisor, and Shared Living Coordinator, providing supports for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities. The person in this role will review Quality Improvement Systems, monitor and direct audits of service quality and compliance, and act as the steward of policies, conventions, and forms used in Active Treatment. This person will supervise quality and content of training; organize and schedule training, and market training outside of CLA. Research, review, and support compliance with applicable state and federal licensing and program rules, laws, and regulations. As a member of the senior leadership team, the Director of Program Quality will work collaboratively with the Executive Director and peers for the best interest of the entire organization and mission.

​Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Social or Human Services, Special Education, or related field and 4 years’ experience working with individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities. Progressively more responsible administrative, fiscal, supervisory, and management experience. Proven success in assisted living, health care, or social service setting. Excellent written, interpersonal, verbal communication, and computer skills; ability to prioritize, organize, and manage multiple tasks effectively.

**Skills**

* Healthcare or IDD quality assurance experience, team leadership, and project management experience in healthcare; demonstrated process improvement and compliance management capabilities.

Pay: $75,000.00 - $90,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Vision insurance

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Work Location: In person
